description:
Send a tip or a reimbursement to a worker on a bounty you own, after their work on it was released. Paid from your wallet when it covers the total. Send an idempotencyKey.
Use for: a tip or an expense after the work is paid. With an idempotencyKey a repeat sends once. Without one, a repeat can send again, and a short wallet gets a card pay link.
Not for: adding money to your wallet (fund_wallet); paying for a draft bounty (fund_bounty).
Needs: an API key. Hosted sign-in cannot call this yet.
Money: US cents.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: send_money({"bountyId":"b7Kq2mXw9TzR4nLp","workerId":"h3Jm8QwLp2Vx","pay":{"amount":1500,"currency":"usd"},"note":"Parking"})
Repeat: A repeat may act again on the thing as it stands then. Read it first.
Errors: wallet_short, payment_already_open, work_not_released, amount_over_limit, worker_blocked, worker_cannot_receive, spending_limit_reached, account_restricted, account_setup_required, idempotency_key_reused; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

bountyId.description: The bounty this worker was hired and paid on: a send always belongs to one, as on the website, where money is sent from the chat about that bounty. If you do not know it, list_conversations shows the bountyId of each chat with a worker.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique string for this call. Repeat it when you retry, so the call runs once.

note.description: A memo for the worker, up to 500 characters.

override.description: true sends although you blocked this worker. Default false.

pay.description: What the worker gets, from $0.50 to $10,000. Our fee is added on top.

workerId.description: The worker's profile id, as on their hire.

name: send_money

expiresAt.description: When the pay link stops working. Left out when sent.

payUrl.description: The card pay link. Left out when sent.

status.description: sent: paid from your wallet. waiting_for_payment: nothing was sent yet; pay `transfer.total` at `payUrl` before `expiresAt`.

title: Send a tip or reimbursement
